MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WITH o, t, CAST(o.birth_date AS STRING) AS birth_date
WITH o, t, 2026 - CAST(SPLIT_PART(birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) - CASE WHEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(SPLIT_PART(birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(SPLIT_PART(birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age >= 67 AND t.team_name <> 'Golden State Warriors'
RETURN age AS col1, t.team_name AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WITH o, t, o.birth_date AS b
WITH o, t,
  CASE WHEN b LIKE '%/%' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(b, '/', 1) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(b, ',', 2)) AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN b LIKE '%/%' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(b, '/', 2) AS INT64) ELSE CASE LOWER(SPLIT_PART(b, ' ', 1)) WHEN 'january' THEN 1 WHEN 'february' THEN 2 WHEN 'march' THEN 3 WHEN 'april' THEN 4 WHEN 'may' THEN 5 WHEN 'june' THEN 6 WHEN 'july' THEN 7 WHEN 'august' THEN 8 WHEN 'september' THEN 9 WHEN 'october' THEN 10 WHEN 'november' THEN 11 WHEN 'december' THEN 12 END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN b LIKE '%/%' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(b, '/', 3) AS INT64) ELSE CAST(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(b, ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64) END AS birth_day
WITH o, t, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owner_age
WHERE owner_age >= 67 AND t.team_name <> 'Golden State Warriors'
RETURN owner_age AS col1, t.team_name AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
